# Versus

> Versus is a comprehensive product comparison platform enabling side-by-side comparisons across 100+ categories including smartphones, computers, GPUs, and lifestyle products.

Versus provides detailed specifications, reviews, and benchmarks for consumer electronics and other products, helping users make informed purchasing decisions. The platform covers major brands like Apple, Samsung, Intel, and Nvidia with extensive product databases and comparison tools.

## Key Topics

- Product comparison
- Smartphone comparison
- Laptop review
- GPU/Graphics card
- CPU/Processor
- Specifications
- Price comparison
- Battery life
- Camera specs
- Apple
- Samsung
- Intel
- Nvidia
- Consumer electronics
- Tech news

## Core Comparison Categories

- [Versus | Compare everything](https://versus.com/en): Main English homepage for Versus product comparison platform
- [Versus Categories](https://versus.com/en/categories): Directory of 100+ product comparison categories on Versus
- [Phone comparisons | Compare cell phones side-by-side - Versus](https://versus.com/en/phone): Smartphone comparison tool for Apple, Samsung, Google, Huawei
- [CPU comparisons | Compare processors & benchmarks - Versus](https://versus.com/en/cpu): Processor comparison with Intel, AMD, Apple CPU benchmarks
- [Graphics card & GPU video card comparison - Versus](https://versus.com/en/graphics-card): GPU comparison tool featuring Nvidia, AMD, Asus, MSI, Gigabyte
- [City comparison | Compare cities around the world - Versus](https://versus.com/en/city): City comparison tool for cost of living, quality of life metrics
- [University comparison | Compare universities around the world - Versus](https://versus.com/en/university): University comparison featuring Harvard, Stanford, Cambridge
- [Instant camera comparison & Personalized instant camera rankings | Versus](https://versus.com/en/instant_camera): Instant camera comparison tool for Instax, Polaroid, Kodak
